$comment: Solana build images per version (06 3.3.1). version -> upstream solana-verifiable-build digest (the IMAGE_MAP of solana-foundation/solana-verifiable-build src/image_config.rs), our derived image (docker/solana-build/Dockerfile, target build: clippy, readable homes, cargo bin outside CARGO_HOME), working_dir W, cargo_home CH, home, active_toolchain (RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN, from `rustup show active-toolchain`, checked at image build). soken_image digests are written by .github/workflows/solana-images.yml (build target, Trivy-gated, pushed to ghcr.io/soken-ltd/solana-build:<version>; `images record-digests`); a zero digest = not published, build_image() returns None. Dev and CI set SOKEN_IMAGE_SOLANA_BUILD_<x_y_z> instead. version_lines: U-S1 row per major.minor; only a passed row lets a build hash give tier A.
